summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the plot_2d_or_3d_image function, and refactored the segmentation, classification, and TensorBoard handlers to delegate to them. Renamed output_path to output_dir in two examples and the sliding-window integration test, and updated the classification test to pass filename. Added five test files. Nothing was executed (tests, flake8, and attach on pytorch-ignite 0.3.0 are unverified); line length and file endings were checked by reading only. No commits were made.
